_meta.name: Stable Video Diffusion XT (no prompt, low VRAM)
_meta.description: SVD-XT animates the image on its own: there is NO motion prompt, you only steer it with motion_bucket_id in the template. 25 frames at 1024x576, runs in ~8 GB VRAM. Output is an animated .webp (no extra ComfyUI dependencies).
notes: Official ComfyUI SVD example in API format. Prompt/negative boxes are hidden because this model has no text input.
Model file: svd_xt_1_1.safetensors (or svd_xt.safetensors) -> ComfyUI/models/checkpoints. svd.safetensors is the 14-frame variant: set frames to 14 for it.
More motion: raise motion_bucket_id in node 3 (default 127, try 180). Less flicker: lower it. augmentation_level adds noise to the input (0.0-0.2).
This preset shows the SaveAnimatedWEBP output route. Swap nodes 7 for CreateVideo + SaveVideo (see the Wan presets) to get .mp4 instead.
SVD is older than Wan but very light and fast; good for quick loops.
